Action: Install and launch app for the first time
Expected Result: Onboarding screen is displayed before Home tab

Action: Grant location permission on onboarding screen
Expected Result: App detects GPS location and displays it in the onboarding fields

Action: Deny location permission on onboarding screen
Expected Result: App shows manual city/zip entry fields and proceeds without GPS

Action: Complete all onboarding steps and tap Continue/Done
Expected Result: App navigates to Home tab and onboarding is not shown on next launch

Action: Open app and view Home tab
Expected Result: Five prayer times displayed: Fajr / Dhuhr / Asr / Maghrib / Isha with correct HH:MM times for current location

Action: Observe next-prayer countdown on Home tab
Expected Result: Countdown timer shows correct time remaining to next prayer and ticks down every second

Action: Wait for or simulate the current next-prayer time to pass
Expected Result: Next prayer label updates to the following prayer and countdown resets correctly

Action: Tap the Qibla button / compass icon on Home tab
Expected Result: Navigates to Qibla compass page

Action: View Home tab when a Masjid is pinned
Expected Result: Pinned masjid name and iqamah times are displayed on the Home tab card

Action: Tap the Quran tab in bottom navigation
Expected Result: Quran tab opens displaying a list of 114 surahs with Arabic names and English transliterations

Action: Tap any surah from the list
Expected Result: Surah reader opens and displays all ayahs with Arabic text

Action: Tap the translation toggle button while in a surah
Expected Result: English translation appears below each Arabic ayah

Action: Tap the translation toggle button again
Expected Result: Translation disappears and only Arabic text is shown

Action: Scroll to the bottom of a long surah (e.g. Al-Baqarah)
Expected Result: All ayahs render without blank areas or crashes

Action: Press Back while in surah reader
Expected Result: Returns to the surah list

Action: Open Tracker tab on a fresh day
Expected Result: All 5 prayers for today shown with pending/incomplete state

Action: Tap a prayer checkbox / button to mark it as completed
Expected Result: Prayer row updates to show completed state (checkmark / green indicator)

Action: Force-close and reopen the app after marking a prayer complete
Expected Result: Previously marked prayer still shows completed state

Action: Tap an already-completed prayer
Expected Result: Prayer toggles back to incomplete state

Action: View Ramadan calendar section in Tracker tab
Expected Result: Calendar grid shows days with done / missed / pending status indicators

Action: Tap a Ramadan day to change its status
Expected Result: Status cycles through done → missed → pending; change persists after restart

Action: Open More tab
Expected Result: Today's date displayed in both Gregorian and Hijri formats

Action: Select a specific Gregorian date on the calendar widget
Expected Result: Corresponding Hijri date updates correctly in the conversion display

Action: Navigate calendar to a previous month
Expected Result: Calendar scrolls back; dates are selectable and Hijri conversion still works

Action: Tap Masjid Finder button in More tab
Expected Result: Masjid Finder page opens

Action: Search by zip code with a valid US zip (e.g. 10001)
Expected Result: A list of nearby masjids within the selected radius is returned

Action: Search by zip code with an invalid value (e.g. 00000)
Expected Result: App shows an empty state or error message; no crash

Action: Adjust the radius slider before searching
Expected Result: Results reflect the updated radius distance

Action: Tap a masjid in the search results
Expected Result: Detail view or action sheet opens showing masjid name and address

Action: Tap the favorite/heart icon on a masjid
Expected Result: Masjid is saved to favorites and icon state changes

Action: Open favorites list after saving a masjid
Expected Result: Previously saved masjid appears in the favorites list

Action: Remove a masjid from favorites
Expected Result: Masjid removed from favorites list

Action: Pin a masjid as My Masjid
Expected Result: Pinned masjid name visible on Home tab; iqamah times card appears

Action: Unpin My Masjid
Expected Result: Home tab reverts to default state without iqamah card

Action: Open Qibla page (via Home tab or Settings)
Expected Result: Compass page opens with Qibla direction arrow visible

Action: Physically rotate device while on Qibla page
Expected Result: Compass needle / Qibla arrow responds to device orientation changes

Action: Compare Qibla direction for a known location (e.g. New York ~58° NE)
Expected Result: Displayed degree is within ±5° of the expected Qibla bearing

Action: Open Settings page
Expected Result: All 5 prayer rows shown with tone selector and notification toggle per prayer

Action: Tap the tone selector for Fajr and choose a different athan
Expected Result: Audio preview plays the selected athan

Action: Select a tone and close Settings; reopen Settings
Expected Result: Previously selected tone is still shown for that prayer

Action: Toggle notifications on for a prayer that was off
Expected Result: System permission prompt appears (if not already granted); notification enabled

Action: Toggle notifications off for an enabled prayer
Expected Result: No notification fires for that prayer at its next scheduled time

Action: Update the location/city in Settings
Expected Result: Prayer times on Home tab recalculate for the new location

Action: Enable notification for the next upcoming prayer
Expected Result: Local notification fires within 30 seconds of prayer time

Action: Observe the notification content
Expected Result: Notification shows correct prayer name (e.g. "Dhuhr") and formatted time

Action: Tap the notification while app is in background
Expected Result: App opens and displays Home tab

Action: Enable notification with Athan tone selected
Expected Result: Selected athan audio plays when notification fires

Action: Enable notification with beep tone selected
Expected Result: Short beep plays instead of full athan

Action: Connect device to Android Auto (physical or emulator) with app installed
Expected Result: App icon appears in Android Auto launcher

Action: Open the app inside Android Auto
Expected Result: Car-optimized UI shows today's 5 prayer times

Action: Observe the highlighted prayer in car UI
Expected Result: Next upcoming prayer is visually highlighted in the list

Action: Change location on phone while in Android Auto
Expected Result: Prayer times in car UI update to reflect new location
